description: Final eight-week multiscale square-root/local-noise MLP screen: eight_final uses unchanged finalized admissions and flu-ED training histories; eight_half_error applies half-strength synthetic reporting errors to those histories. Both learn36 finalized weekly labels using original weekly/path/peak losses; each heldout fold trains other three seasons among2022-23 through2025-26, seeds44/45. Evaluated on strict archived Wednesday reports without finalized fallback in2024-25/2025-26 and final NHSN seasonal peak truth. Retrospective development, not forward-only validation. Separates eight-week history benefit from input-error augmentation; no claimed gain.
